title: Let’s review what we learned
intro: Salah, the jama‘ah, janazah, fasting, Zakah, Hajj, the hadith collections, ghusl and marriage – let’s repeat it all.

learn.html: We have learned about Salah and the other Islamic duties. Answer these questions with your muallim, then do the activities below.

items: What is the first pillar of the Islamic faith?
What are the fard parts of Salah?
What is the janazah, and what are the fard parts of the janazah?
What is fasting (sawm), and who must fast?
the actions of a mukallaf (af‘al al-mukallafin) and how they are divided
the sahib al-‘udhr (a person with a lasting excuse) and the rules for them
The first thing a person will be asked about on the Day of Judgement is ________. If it is ________, the rest will be right too; if it is not right, the rest will not be right either.

Conditions for the janazah prayer to be valid: the person who died is a ________; the body is ________ (has had ghusl) and wrapped in a ________ (shroud); the body is placed ________ the jama‘ah; its right side is turned toward the ________.
We give condolences with the words: “________” – Truly, Allah is with the patient. The family answers: “________” – We belong to Allah and to Him we return.
Zakah must be given by Muslims who: really own more than ________; have owned at least the nisab for a whole ________; and whose wealth still reaches the ________ at the end of the year.

Among the best-known and most trusted hadith collections are Sahih ________ and Sahih ________. After them come the Sunan of Abu ________, ________, ________ and Ibn ________. Together they are called the ________ – the six books. Also worth mentioning is the M________, the hadith collection of Imam ________.
Marriage in the Shari‘ah is a contract between a man and a woman who ________ and meet the conditions for marriage. It is based on their free ________, with ________ witnesses.

practice.title: Fard, wajib, sunnah or makruh?
practice.prompt: Sort each part of Salah into the right group.

items.text: Reciting the Qunut dua in witr
Feet a hand’s width apart in qiyam
Giving salam first to the right, then to the left
Praying in a row with a gap in the row in front
Making the second rak‘ah longer than the first

practice.title: True or false?
practice.prompt: Tap every sentence that is TRUE, then tap Check.

options.text: Sadaqat al-fitr is given at the end of Ramadan.
The Prophet (SAW) said prayer in congregation is worth 27 times more than prayer alone.
Zakah is giving wealth for everyone, whether they can afford it or not.
options.why: Zakah is a duty only for those who own more than the nisab for a whole year.

options.text: Hajj is the first Islamic duty.
options.why: The first pillar of Islam is the Shahadah. Hajj is the fifth, and only for those who are able.

options.text: Ghusl is just an ordinary bath.
options.why: Ghusl is a washing of the whole body done in a set way, with the intention of worship.

options.text: A sahib al-‘udhr cannot pray at all.
options.why: A sahib al-‘udhr makes wudu for the time of each prayer and can pray every prayer.

practice.title: Match the word and its meaning
